rules.name: a1f3c0de-100a-4a0a-9b0a-0d2e4f6a8c0a
rules.displayName: Executable or Script Dropped in User-Writable Path
rules.description: Detects creation of executable or script files (.exe, .dll, .ps1, .bat, .vbs, .hta, .js) in user-writable staging directories (Temp, Downloads, AppData\Roaming) — characteristic of payload staging / ingress tool transfer.
rules.query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where (FolderPath contains "\\temp\\" or FolderPath contains "\\downloads\\" or FolderPath contains "\\appdata\\roaming\\") and (FolderPath endswith ".exe" or FolderPath endswith ".dll" or FolderPath endswith ".ps1" or FolderPath endswith ".bat" or FolderPath endswith ".vbs" or FolderPath endswith ".hta" or FolderPath endswith ".js")

rules.name: a1f3c0de-1003-4a03-ab03-0d2e4f6a8c03
rules.displayName: Script Host or LOLBin Making Network Connection
rules.description: Detects script interpreters and living-off-the-land binaries initiating network connections — frequently command-and-control or remote payload retrieval rather than benign activity.
rules.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\wscript.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\cscript.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\mshta.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\regsvr32.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\rundll32.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\certutil.exe"

rules.name: a1f3c0de-1001-4a01-8b01-0d2e4f6a8c01
rules.displayName: Suspicious Process Spawned by Office or Browser Application
rules.description: Detects living-off-the-land binaries (powershell, cmd, wscript, mshta, regsvr32, rundll32, certutil, bitsadmin, wmic) spawned by an Office application or browser — a common phishing initial-access execution chain.
rules.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\winword.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\excel.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\powerpnt.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\outlook.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\acrord32.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\chrome.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\firefox.exe" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath endswith "\\msedge.exe") and (FolderPath endswith "\\powershell.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\cmd.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\wscript.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\cscript.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\mshta.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\regsvr32.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\rundll32.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\certutil.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\bitsadmin.exe" or FolderPath endswith "\\wmic.exe")

rules.name: a1f3c0de-1002-4a02-9b02-0d2e4f6a8c02
rules.description: Detects encoded PowerShell command lines and in-memory download/execution patterns (FromBase64String, IEX, DownloadString, DownloadFile, BITS transfer) commonly used to stage and run payloads.
rules.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "-enc" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-encodedcommand" or ProcessCommandLine contains "frombase64string" or ProcessCommandLine contains "iex " or ProcessCommandLine contains "invoke-expression" or ProcessCommandLine contains "downloadstring" or ProcessCommandLine contains "downloadfile" or ProcessCommandLine contains "bitstransfer"

rules.name: a1f3c0de-1006-4a06-9b06-0d2e4f6a8c06
rules.description: Detects modification of common registry autostart/persistence locations (Run keys, Winlogon, Image File Execution Options, AppInit_DLLs, AppCertDLLs) used to survive reboot or hijack execution.
rules.query:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where RegistryKey contains "CurrentVersion\\Run" or RegistryKey contains "Winlogon" or RegistryKey contains "Image File Execution" or RegistryKey contains "AppInit_DLL" or RegistryKey contains "AppCertDll"
